segments.text: Eleven Black Friday gifts actually worth watching, from twelve dollars, and the one catch to know before you buy each one.
Quick note: our links are affiliate links. It never changes our picks. Prices move daily, so always check the link.

segments.name: KONG Classic dog toy
segments.text: Number one. The KONG Classic dog toy, about twelve dollars. Fill it with treats and a dog stays busy for ages. The catch? Size matters. Too small is a choking risk, so match it to the dog.
segments.catch: Match the size to the dog. Too small is a choking risk.

segments.name: Apple AirTag
segments.text: Two. The Apple AirTag, about twenty-three dollars. Clip it to keys or a suitcase and find it from an iPhone. The catch? It only works with iPhones. For Android, get a Samsung SmartTag or a Tile.
segments.catch: iPhone only. Android? Get a SmartTag or Tile.

segments.name: Soundcore noise-cancelling earbuds
segments.text: Three. Anker Soundcore noise-cancelling earbuds, about twenty-five dollars. Noise cancelling and around ten hours of play, at a stocking-stuffer price. The catch? They soften a commute, but they won't match two-hundred-dollar earbuds.
segments.catch: Good, not premium. They won't match $200 earbuds.

segments.name: Wearable sherpa blanket
segments.text: Four. A wearable sherpa blanket, about twenty-five dollars. Half hoodie, half blanket, with a big front pocket. The catch? It's one size and bulky. It's for the sofa, not for going out.
segments.catch: One size and bulky. Sofa only.

segments.label: The kitchen
segments.sub: Gifts that get used every day

segments.name: Lodge cast iron skillet
segments.text: Five. The Lodge cast iron skillet, about twenty dollars. Pre-seasoned, goes from stove to oven, and lasts a lifetime. The catch? It's heavy, and it needs drying and a little oil after washing.
segments.catch: Heavy. Dry it and oil it after washing.

segments.name: Instant Pot Duo, 6 qt
segments.text: Six. The Instant Pot Duo, six quarts, about seventy dollars. Pressure cooker, slow cooker and rice cooker in one. The catch? It takes counter space, and pressure cooking has a short learning curve.
segments.catch: Needs counter space, and a little practice.

segments.name: Ninja Crispi Pro air fryer
segments.text: Seven. The Ninja Crispi Pro glass air fryer, about a hundred and ninety-nine dollars. Cook, serve, and store in the same glass dish, so there's no basket to scrub. The catch? The glass dish is heavier than a normal basket.
segments.catch: The glass dish is heavier than a basket.

segments.text: Still coming: a mouse built for long workdays, and a styler that does much of what a seven-hundred-dollar one does.

segments.name: BenQ ScreenBar light
segments.text: Eight. The BenQ ScreenBar monitor light, about a hundred and nine dollars. It sits on the monitor and lights the desk, with no glare on the screen. The catch? It needs a monitor. It won't sit on a laptop.
segments.catch: Needs a monitor, not a laptop.

segments.name: Logitech MX Master 4
segments.text: Nine. The Logitech MX Master four mouse, about a hundred and twenty dollars. Logitech's flagship work mouse, with a fast scroll wheel and a thumb wheel. The catch? It's big and right-handed only. Small hands may prefer the MX Anywhere.

segments.name: Kindle Colorsoft
segments.text: Ten. The Kindle Colorsoft, about two hundred and ninety dollars. A glare-free color screen for books, comics and highlights. The catch? Color is softer than a tablet. For plain novels, a regular Kindle costs less.
segments.catch: Softer color than a tablet. Novels only? Get a regular Kindle.

segments.name: Shark FlexFusion styler
segments.text: And eleven. The Shark FlexFusion air styler, about two hundred and ninety-nine dollars. It dries, curls and straightens with swappable attachments. The catch? It's still a big spend. If they only dry their hair, a good dryer costs far less.
segments.catch: A big spend. Only drying? A good dryer costs far less.

segments.text: If you only buy one: the AirTag as a stocking stuffer, the Instant Pot for the kitchen, or the FlexFusion as the splurge for less.
Every pick is linked in the description and the pinned comment, with the full watchlist for the US and the UK. Happy shopping.
